title: Add X-Request-Id middleware
task: Add request-id middleware to the Express app: every response (including 404s for unknown routes) must carry an X-Request-Id header. If the incoming request already has an X-Request-Id header, echo that value back unchanged; otherwise generate a UUID with crypto.randomUUID() from node:crypto. Put the middleware in its own module under src/middleware/ and register it in src/index.js before the routes. Do not add dependencies.
